mapper.sql: request_id requestId,user_id userId,user_name userName,applicant_id applicantId,applicant_name applicantName,date_format(effective_date,'%Y-%m-%d') effectiveDate,reason,snapshot_json snapshotJson,status,close_reason closeReason,created_at createdAt
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} for update
select from biz_staff_allocation_request where user_id=#{userId} order by request_id desc limit 10
select owner_user_id ownerUserId,owner_name ownerName,project_id projectId,status,comment,reviewed_at reviewedAt from biz_staff_allocation_review where request_id=#{requestId} order by owner_user_id

select r.request_id requestId,r.user_id userId,r.user_name userName,r.applicant_name applicantName, date_format(r.effective_date,'%Y-%m-%d') effectiveDate,v.project_id projectId from biz_staff_allocation_review v join biz_staff_allocation_request r on r.request_id=v.request_id where v.owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} and v.status='PENDING' and r.status='PENDING' order by r.request_id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_staff_allocation_review(request_id,owner_user_id,owner_name,project_id,status,reviewed_at) values(#{requestId},#{ownerUserId},#{ownerName},#{projectId},#{status},case when #{status}='APPROVED' then now() else null end)
mapper.update: update biz_staff_allocation_review set status=#{status},comment=#{comment},reviewed_at=now() where request_id=#{requestId} and owner_user_id=#{ownerId} and status='PENDING'
update biz_staff_allocation_request set status=#{status},close_reason=#{reason},pending_user_id=null,updated_at=now() where request_id=#{requestId} and status='PENDING'
